The frontend hook is `useMemos` from `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`.

The client file is `web/src/connect.ts`. The proto RPC is `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (ListMemos). The backend handler is `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`. The store method is `store/memo.go`. One dialect implementation is `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`.

q12.
frontend hook — `useMemos` — `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`
client file — `web/src/connect.ts`
proto RPC — `ListMemos` — `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`
backend handler file — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`
store method file — `store/memo.go`
dialect implementation file — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`

**Path summary:** `useMemos` (also `useInfiniteMemos` in the same file) calls `memoServiceClient.listMemos` from `web/src/connect.ts`, which hits the `ListMemos` RPC in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`. The backend handler `APIV1Service.ListMemos` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `s.Store.ListMemos` in `store/memo.go`, which delegates to the dialect driver — e.g. `(d *DB) ListMemos` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (Postgres and MySQL equivalents live in `store/db/postgres/memo.go` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`).
